title: Acute Posttraumatic Osteomyelitis in Patients With High-energy Tibial Fractures and Biomarkers
brief_summary: The present trial was aimed to identify which biomarkers could be associated in perioperative period after surgical treatment of tibial fracture to the development of POM.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* high-energy injury to proximal, shaft or distal tibia,
* tibial fracture requiring primary surgical treatment /ORIF

Exclusion Criteria:

* ankle fracture,
* patella fracture,
* avulsion fracture of the knee,
* malignant neoplasm and pathological tibial fracture,
* systemic autoimmune disease of connective tissue,
* immature patients under 15 years of age (children),
* immunocompromised patients.
study_population: Patients admitted to the Department of Traumatology at University Clinical Centre Ljubljana were included after written informed consent.
